direction: Компактный интерфейсный гротеск с умеренной гуманистической пластикой и самостоятельной кириллицей

decisions.title: Направленное натяжение чаш
decisions.change: Family-specific upper-pole displacement and positive handle scaling; moderate intensity, reduced small/heavy amplitude and 22% thin upper-right round relief.

verdict.reason: Upper-left direction repeats in cocoa and основа. Thin o/O/0 retains a curved upper-right transition after relief; further amplification is unnecessary. Cyrillic а/Р/в are included in the shared bowl families and reviewed at both optical extremes.
verdict.arbiter: root agent; not a human readability study

decisions.title: Открытые формы и окончания
decisions.change: Shared c/с/e/е/ё/э openings and terminal adjustments; reduced heavy e crossbar thickness.

verdict.reason: c/с and e/е/э retain identifiable openings. Heavy e crossbar relief preserves separation from the lower terminal.
verdict.arbiter: root agent; not a human readability study

decisions.title: Различимые силуэты
decisions.change: Short I crossbars and smooth l lower exit, preserving advances; retain two-storey a, single-storey g and flagged 1.

verdict.reason: I has short bars, l has a lower exit, 1 has a flag. Two-storey a and single-storey g remain clear in the reviewed strings.
verdict.arbiter: root agent; not a human readability study

decisions.title: Самостоятельная кириллица
decisions.change: Short smooth Л/л exit and coordinated Д/д transition; lighten heavy Ж/ж, К/к, Я/я joins; preserve upright п/т.

verdict.reason: Л/л has a restrained left exit coherent with Д/д. п/т remain upright; heavy Ж/К/Я retain their familiar skeleton without decorative additions.
verdict.arbiter: root agent; not a human readability study

decisions.title: Непрерывность и оптическая компенсация
decisions.change: Continuous weight/optical attenuation on shared master topology, with positive handle scaling and thin round relief.

verdict.reason: Intermediate-axis geometry, continuous advance data, fixed-corpus layout and independent build checks pass; all 189 characters and both axes remain present.
verdict.arbiter: root agent; not a human readability study

decisions.title: Компактность и полный набор
decisions.change: Retained 189 characters and both variation axes, unchanged advances and layout tables, compact WOFF2 export.
